notes.title: RRRS v1.3.0 Patch
notes.content: [p][i]Run with the red shoes till the end of the earth![/i][/p][p]Hello, Here is Koil from Madmud Studio.[/p][p]Game patched recently, and the patch list is shown below.[/p][p][/p][p]Locked mouse click when transition animation plays in main menu.[/p][p]Fixed an error of impossible choosing Cafe when you use up arrow.[/p][p]Now cursor will follow what section you clicked in survivor mode.[/p][p]Now you can change limit time when you are about to choose the stage.[/p][p]Now space bar will work in select.[/p][p]Synced the position of both character and stage list scroll bar.[/p][p]Improved wall detect time.[/p][p]Now WASD will work.[/p][p]Now tutorial language will apply in main game.[/p][p]Added navigation of mission item in story mode.[/p][p]Added setting menu in pause menu.[/p]

notes.title: RRRS v1.2.1 Update
notes.content:
[i]Wear red shoes and run till the end of earth![/i]
Hello, I'm Koil from Madmud Studio.
The game has been updated mid-sized, and the changes are as follows.

[h3]Bug Fixed[/h3]
- Fixed bugs about "Fullscreen" setting.
- Fixed bugs about force fullscreen mode when select menu with cursor.
- Fixed bugs about the wind fireball that doesn't work.
- Fixed sfx crashes when setting sfx volume to 0.
- Now totems will not be pushed by both player and enemy.
- Now the press will not push player.
- Fixed the bug about upgrade gauge image.
- Now enemies will not spawn in the wall.
- Fixed the bug about hit effect position.
- Now you can't pick ability double.
- Now the screen will not shake when in ability select.
- Reinforced wall through lock mechanism

[h3]Changed[/h3]
- Lower the [Attack increase Condition] cost.
- Buffed [Attack increase Condition], [Speed increase Value] with increasing number of effect by upgrade level.
- Made survivor and hardcore mode easier by increasing enemy spawn cooltime.
- Changed fixed moving enemy's apparance.
- Increased [Oil] ability's remain time, and decreased the size of [Oil] ability.
- Now [Oil] will spawn during 1 sec per 3 sec.
- Changed the speed of exp ball's chase speed

notes.title: RRRS v1.2.0 Patch
notes.content:
[i]Wear red shoes and run till the end of earth![/i]
Hello, I'm Koil from Madmud Studio.
The game has been updated mid-sized, and the changes are as follows.

[h3]Bug Fixed [/h3]
- Now, even if you keep running towards the wall, the speed doesn't increase.
- Now, if you are in contact with the wall for a certain period of time, you will go to the start point of the stage.
- Fixed a bug in Story Mode where you can't see any totems to destroy on the mini-map.
- Now, not only the ending credits, but also the game intro screen will examine whether the story completion challenge has been achieved.

[h3]Added [/h3]
- [b]Three new abilities have been added! [/b]
==> If you don't change the direction for a certain period of time, the speed increases instantaneously. Reduce time conditions when level-up.
==> Launch a fireball in proportion to the previous speed whenever you change direction. Increase the number of fireball when level-up.
==> Explosion occurs every time MAXSPEED is terminated. Increasing the number of explosions when level-up.

notes.title: RRRS v1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Hello, here's Koil from Madmud Studio.
We updated the game, the changed things are listed below.

[h3]Fixed[/h3] 
- Now game doesn't crash when succeed the achievement.
- Improved Wall-through problem.
- Increased the size of item after defeating boss in story mode.
- Fixed tutorial language bugs.

[h3]Changed[/h3]
- Expanded the passage of Cafe stage 

[h3]Added[/h3]
- Now you can pick ability by clicking!
